## Purpose

Calculate how much phytoplankton to mix to obtain the desired carbon ratio between different species.

```sh
quarto render calculations/food_calculator.qmd
```

$$
\begin{array}{l}
M_{P}^{\mathrm{jar}}
    = D_P \times V_J \\[8pt]

M_{P}^{\mathrm{tot}}
    = M_{P}^{\mathrm{jar}} \times n_J \\[8pt]

n_J
    = \text{number of jars} \\[2pt]

V_J
    = \text{volume of one jar} \\[2pt]

D_P
    = \text{phytoplankton density} \\[2pt]

M_{P}^{\mathrm{jar}}
    = \text{phytoplankton mass per jar} \\[2pt]

M_{P}^{\mathrm{tot}}
    = \text{total phytoplankton mass}
\end{array}
$$

M = mass (only C)

V = volume 

n = number
 
D = density 

Input:
- Number of Daphnia cultures
- Optical density of the Synechococcus sample
- Optical density of the Tetradesmus sample
- Optical density of the Microcystis sample
- Optical density of the Nannochloropsis sample

Output:
- Volume of Microcystis
- Volume of Synechococcus
- Volume of Nannochloropsis
- Volume of Tetradesmus
- Volume per Daphnia jar Microcystis + Tetradesmus
- Volume per Daphnia jar Synechococcus + Tetradesmus
- Volume per Daphnia jar Nannochloropsis
- Volume of mix Microcystis + Tetradesmus
- Volume of mix Synechococcus + Tetradesmus
- Volume of Nannochloropsis

The app's parameters (jar volume, target carbon concentration, and each species' OD-to-carbon calibration) are not typed in below by hand. A standalone Shinylive app like this one runs client-side in the reader's browser and has no access to this document's R session or to the repository's data files, so instead the code block is generated at render time from `calculations/food_calculator_parameters.csv` — a snapshot written by [5a_calculations_OD.qmd](../5a_calculations_OD.qmd) from the live calibration fit. Re-rendering the master document (or just 5a_calculations_OD.qmd) refreshes that snapshot; re-rendering this file then bakes the refreshed numbers into the app below.

````{r}
#| label: load_parameters
#| include: false

Food_calculator_parameters <- read.csv(
  here::here("calculations", "food_calculator_parameters.csv")
)
````

````{r}
#| label: emit_app
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

param_assignments <- paste(
  sprintf("    %s <- %s", Food_calculator_parameters$name, Food_calculator_parameters$value),
  collapse = "\n"
)
param_names_r <- paste(deparse(Food_calculator_parameters$name), collapse = " ")
param_values_r <- paste(deparse(Food_calculator_parameters$value), collapse = " ")

app_code <- sprintf('
````
